planets.name: GJ 1132 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of GJ 1132 with a 1.63-day year, found in 2015.

text.card: GJ 1132 b was found in 2015 by Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around GJ 1132. Its orbit and size follow Xue et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname XUE_ET_AL_2024): disc_year 2015, disc_facility Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory, sy_pnum 2; pl_orbper 1.62892911, pl_radj 0.1063, pl_bmassj 0.00578

quotes.title: GJ 1132 b
quotes.card: GJ 1132 b is an exoplanet orbiting GJ 1132, a red dwarf star 41 light-years from Earth, in the constellation Vela.
quotes.introduction: The planet is considered uninhabitable but was thought to be cool enough to possess an atmosphere.
